primary_metric: arithmetic mean per-request client TPOT, (last event-first event)*1000/(2048-1)
method: Pause P; admit D requests; bootstrap grace; pause D; resume P; require all P KV-transfer-completed records; resume the decode worker
readiness: Exact phase request count of P RequestStats finished after RDMA transfer; all client outputs must occur after this gate
limitation: Staging TTFT is artificial; this tests decode capacity, not normal end-to-end service latency
comparison_note: Single C128 vs dual C256 have same per-rank batch; single capacity raised to support C256 rank batch32
